parsed.explanation: After proving only that V has at most one positive value, the write-up’s dichotomy is not exhaustive: V={c} with c>0 is possible and corresponds to the valid constant-difference solutions. The later argument explicitly assumes both 0 and c occur, so it does not cover that omitted case. A sentence separating V={c} (immediately yielding g≡c) from the mixed case would repair this particular gap. The write-up should also explicitly derive g≥0 from positivity of the iterates before asserting V⊆{0,c}.
